objective: Diagnose current B1 missed weak precipitation and false alarms, and include the dominant new 5 mm false alarms of rejected grouped candidate C. This batch neither defines a new initialization rule nor changes the frozen 26 adoption conditions.

cases.ORIGINAL: 규준실험; initial state and historical KDM6 before the exact-zero transfer fix
cases.A: 현재 B1; background-precip-preserving initialization, zero-rate FIX, old PH sum
cases.C: Rejected B1 grouped PH sum; isolate C-A arithmetic effect
cases.D: Rejected DM065 grouped PH sum; context only
cases.B1_OLD_KDM6: Existing ORIGINAL_B1_100 same B1 initialization, old KDM6 zero-rate branch and old PH sum; diagnostic state/surface comparison A-X only, not a new forecast or eligible candidate

classification.event_boundary: prediction >= threshold and reference >= threshold; observed bins [0,.1),[.1,1),[1,5),[5,infinity)
classification.weak_observation: 0.1 <= RN1 < 1 mm with prediction >= .1 mm; separate from whole-cohort low-threshold CSI
classification.membership: Unique flat_index_yx per focus_membership row; keep all multi-role labels; separate event_membership long rows for lead, threshold and amounts. No repeated-role independent sample claim.
classification.controls: Deterministic nearest unused retained/stable controls within the same observed band for each failing cohort; lower flat index breaks exact distance ties; controls can be reused across different cohorts only with explicit audit. Also compare all 53 new with all24 resolved +2 h false alarms. Matching does not establish identical physical conditions.

diagnostics.neighborhood_rule: Include the query point and record point counts. Use only existing paired RN1 coordinates. Empty threshold sets produce explicit invalid/null values. Nearest-threshold distances and neighbor ranges are contextual; do not compute neighborhood-adjusted CSI or call these trajectories/displacement causes.
diagnostics.temporal_rule: All six one-hour values plus h4+h5+h6 sums, peak hour, and h5 fraction where sum>0. Distinguish interval total up/down with evaluation-hour decrease; do not infer actual timing shift, transport or evaporation from point sums.
diagnostics.csi_algebra: With fixed O=H+M, delta CSI = [deltaH*(O+F_A)-H_A*deltaF]/[(O+F_A)*(O+F_C)]. Record exact fractions and separate H/F algebra terms; these are not physical causal contributions. Evaluate hit-only repair with F_C unchanged.
diagnostics.selection_criteria: The original 26 independent lead-threshold criteria remain fixed; no average CSI or gate-count rank and no new eligible candidate.

state_extraction.stage: Separate input/corner/output plan is frozen after target receipt and source identities are available, before extraction.
state_extraction.mapping: Existing canonical WRF bilinear four corners/weights, source and coordinate identities pinned; retain native zero-based indexes plus explicit Fortran one-based display.
state_extraction.diagnostics: Reuse pinned cp02_failure_state_features temperature/RH/Dm functions: dry T perturbation distinct from THM; per-corner nonlinear diagnostics before spatial weights; native REAL32 and weighted REAL64 kept separately. Undefined Dm stays NaN at required invalid corners. History-derived temperatures and relative humidity are diagnostics, not captured KDM6 process states.
state_extraction.gravity_and_mass: 9.81 m/s² is the inherited height diagnostic convention. Archive raw hybrid coefficients and MU/MUB, but no dry-mass/water-budget claim without actual constant/time/flux validation.
state_extraction.surface: Component native cumulative differences before spatial weighting; verify hourly total RAINC+RAINNC against sealed paired arrays for all selected points, with explicit REAL64 rounding allowance. Validate exact Times, no resets/buckets/RAINSH contract bypass.

open_items: No new physical modification is justified merely by threshold transitions. Choose at most one next hypothesis only after joint failure/control state evidence.
The existing B1/ORIGINAL criteria and C/D rejection remain unchanged.
Single event, RN1 upstream time/coverage/QC, independent-case skill, domain water/energy budgets and separate C2 T39/H-A-N completion remain unresolved.
